statements.text: The DC resistance of this test instrument (TI) was measured at the current listed below by comparison to a standard shunt. Measurements were taken after the TI exhibited a condition of temperature equilibrium. The TI was found to be in tolerance. The results in this report relate only to the item(s) calibrated. There are no special limitations of use imposed on the calibration item.
Calibration results are listed on the following page(s).

The expanded uncertainty of the TI is the uncertainty the TI is expected to remain within for the duration of the calibration interval. All uncertainties were calculated per NIST Technical Note 1297, “Guidelines for Evaluating and Expressing the Uncertainty of NIST Measurement Results” using a coverage factor of k=2 for a confidence level of 95%.
